📌The oppressed and cowardly martyrdom of the martyred Dr. Nusrat Eftekhari, Deputy for Cultural and Social Affairs of the Police Command of Sistan and Baluchestan Province, on the path of serving the people, is a bitter and sorrowful loss. Now the time has come to repay these loans, and the government is forced to take out new loans at much higher interest rates to settle them.📌On the other hand, the capacity and willingness of bond buyers is steadily declining. For example, major buyers of US bonds (such as China and Japan) are showing less interest in buying new bonds or holding onto existing ones, and for this reason bond yields are rising.📌Qalibaf has reminded Bessent that Iran's role in keeping the Strait of Hormuz closed and keeping energy prices high, as well as its influence on driving up bond yields, has confronted the US Treasury with a growing crisis and exacerbated all his troubles; in other words, the Americans will not be able to overcome these economic problems until they resolve these issues by respecting the rights of the Iranian nation.📌The interest rate on 30-year US government bonds yesterday reached its highest level since 2002, and with the current trend, there is a possibility of a return to the rates of the 1990s and before.📌Qalibaf also used in his post an image of David Zervos, Bessent's new advisor who was appointed yesterday. He is known for making bizarre statements. For example, years ago he claimed he would refrain from cutting his hair and beard until the Federal Reserve lowered interest rates!
